image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of three green cucumbers arranged on a plain white surface. The foreground cucumber is large and in sharp focus, showing detailed skin texture with small bumps and water droplets. Two other cucumbers are visible in the background, slightly out of focus, creating depth. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the waxy sheen of the rind.

Standard depth-of-field blur is present. However, the transition between the sharp foreground and blurred background is exceptionally clean, potentially indicating synthetic generation rather than optical lens blur, but no hard artifacts are visible.
